q: Which Google tool is most suitable for a live virtual conversation with a guest speaker?
exp: Meet is the primary video-conferencing tool.

q: A participant benefits from live captions during an online lesson. What should you enable?
exp: Meet captions support accessibility during live sessions.

q: Which two practices improve an online meeting for participants with different needs? (Select two.)
exp: Captions and advance materials improve accessibility and participation.

q: You need to email a group of colleagues about a schedule change. What makes the message easier to understand and retrieve later?
choices: Use a clear subject line and concise message
Send only an image with no context
exp: Clear subjects and concise messages improve communication and retrieval.

q: A teacher wants to notify students of a Classroom update without starting a graded task. Which option is suitable?
exp: Announcements are designed for class updates.

q: Which Gmail feature can help organize incoming messages from parents automatically?
exp: Filters can apply labels based on sender or other criteria.

q: A teacher needs to quickly find emails from principal@school.org that include attachments. Which search is most effective?
exp: Gmail search operators narrow results efficiently.

q: Which communication method is most appropriate for a scheduled video conference that should also appear on participants' calendars?
choices: Create a Calendar event with a Meet link
exp: Calendar and Meet work together for scheduled video conferences.

q: A student missed a live lesson. Which response best supports continuity?
choices: Provide organized follow-up materials and instructions in the class workspace
Ask the student to guess what happened
exp: Organized follow-up resources support flexible access and continuity.

q: A teacher wants all messages from a specific project to be easy to find. What is useful in Gmail?
choices: Sort a Sheet by color only
exp: Labels provide a reusable way to organize related messages.

q: Which two actions help make written digital instructions clearer? (Select two.)
choices: Break complex steps into a logical sequence
Use one long paragraph with no structure
Rely only on color to convey meaning
exp: Headings and logically ordered steps improve clarity.

q: You want to send a message to several people while keeping the conversation in one email thread. Which tool is most appropriate?
exp: Gmail is designed for threaded email communication.

q: What is the best reason to include context in a Calendar invitation description?
choices: Guests can understand the purpose and prepare before the meeting
exp: Event descriptions help invitees understand the purpose and prepare.

q: A teacher wants to avoid interrupting students with repeated emails about the same class update. What is a better approach?
choices: Post one clear Classroom announcement and update it if needed
Send the same email every hour
exp: A single clear announcement reduces unnecessary communication.

q: Which two items are useful to include in a virtual meeting invitation? (Select two.)
choices: A random file with no explanation
exp: A meeting invitation should make the purpose, timing, and access clear.

q: A student has difficulty reading small text. Which response reflects good digital accessibility practice?
choices: Use readable formatting and built-in zoom/accessibility options
Tell the student to use a different class
exp: Readable formatting and accessibility tools support different learner needs.
